This Cable Leader USB 3.2 Gen 2 USB-C to USB-C cable does all three: 10Gbps SuperSpeed data transfer, 4K at 60Hz video over DisplayPort Alt Mode, and 60W (20V/3A) USB Power Delivery charging through one reversible connection. All four SuperSpeed pairs and both sideband pins are wired, with an E-Marker chip for safe PD negotiation, foil-plus-braid double shielding, 24 AWG power conductors, and fully molded strain relief at both ends. Compatible with MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iPad Pro, Surface Pro, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Steam Deck, and Samsung T7 or SanDisk Extreme portable SSDs, plus USB-C docks and monitors - it does not reach Thunderbolt 40Gbps speeds or charge above 60W. Offered in black and white. Best for: one-cable data, video, and charging on USB-C laptops, tablets, and external drives. Not for: Thunderbolt 3/4 40Gbps transfers or 100W laptop charging.
